headline: OpenAI has added an agent for analysing business data to ChatGPT Work.
score_reason: Pool 6 lowered by 1: only the headline is known, so what the agent does and who can use it is unverified.
importance_line: What changed is a new analytics agent in OpenAI's workplace product, which would affect business teams that analyse company data first, then rivals selling data tools, and the doubt is that what the agent can do, what it costs and who can use it are not yet clear.
summary: Investing.com reports that OpenAI has launched a Data agent for business analytics in ChatGPT Work, OpenAI's general task agent.
